name: prob_dist
description: Probability distributions and exact counting: pmf or pdf, cdf, survival, interval probability, quantile, mean and variance of the binomial, Poisson, normal, hypergeometric, geometric, negative binomial, exponential and uniform distributions, and n choose k, permutations, multisets and multinomial coefficients. Discrete distributions with rational parameters are exact fractions (binomial(10, 1/2) P(X = 5) is 63/256).

n.description: binomial trials (at most 2000); choose and permutations

p.description: success probability, a number or a decimal or fraction string; binomial, geometric, negative_binomial

successes.description: hypergeometric K, success states in the population

r.description: negative_binomial: successes; X counts the failures before the r-th

x.description: Point: pmf or pdf, cdf P(X <= x) and survival P(X > x)

q.description: Probability for the quantile; discrete: smallest k with P(X <= k) >= q

repetition.description: choose: multisets C(n + k - 1, k); permutations: n^k

catalog.source: Standard definitions as in scipy.stats (geometric counts trials, negative binomial counts failures); Poisson cdf through the regularized incomplete gamma function (Numerical Recipes, ch. 6.2); normal cdf through math.erfc and quantile through statistics.NormalDist (Wichura's AS241)
